title: 有馬記念の後に・燃料、満タンで

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun runs with everything she's got and emerges victorious. Delighted after defeating Narita Brian, she can't contain her excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She then realizes that Narita Brian is not yet satisfied, so…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides to give her yet another exciting bout at the Hanshin Daishoten.
